status: bounded scale-growth case repaired, qualified and committed

fixture.selection: Exactly one real root, t=1; every quadratic factor is positive. Q(1)=1, so the intended sign is positive under every nonzero defining scale.
fixture.field: Existing public OrderedFieldPolynomialContext<Real>, with exact integer operations and signs. Record coefficient magnitudes and decline after a constructed coefficient exceeds 16,384 bits.

direction: Normalize positive common scale across polynomial coefficients in their existing coefficient field before it compounds through later signed remainders. Use one shared field-owned operation rather than another root or point carrier; retain all selected-field/root identities.
existing_hypercurve_machinery: BezierRecursiveQuadraticValue2::primitive_projective_ratio already removes positive common rational content across a retained recursive tuple, memoizes shared nodes while rebuilding, preserves every generator field, and declines nonrational payloads. It currently accepts a fixed-size array and has one production caller. Consider generalizing this same machinery to polynomial coefficient slices and migrating that caller directly.
api_constraint: OrderedFieldPolynomialContext currently owns arithmetic and sign operations but no projective polynomial normalization. Establish the bounded regression and exact scaling contract before extending this shared interface. Update every context implementation directly; do not add a compatibility interface. Unavailable content normalization must retain the original exact coefficients, never reject the supported scalar family.
proof_obligations: Only a certified positive common scale may be removed: every polynomial sign and Sturm variation must be unchanged. Negative defining gauges, repeated roots and selected proper factors must remain correct.
No coordinatewise or independent per-coefficient scale changes. Preserve the field generators, raw support domains, poles and selected-root evidence.
Retain actual-value scale in ordinary quotient-ring arithmetic; projective normalization applies only where sign or zero-set semantics make that scale irrelevant.
Use existing arbitrary exact Real guards explicitly. A nonrational coefficient is not an invalid point or an unavailable geometric representation.
Avoid partially mutating coefficient slices if optional normalization declines; no repeated full scalar/root reconstruction.
regression: P=(t-1)(t^2+1)(t^2+2)(t^2+3) selects t=1 in (0,2). Eighteen combinations of defining gauges (positive, negative, large, fractional) and independently scaled positive, negative and vanishing predicates all complete below the 256-bit coefficient budget.

result.baseline: Defining scales +1 and -1 peak at 1,187 bits; 65,536 exceeds the 16,384-bit budget with a 21,235-bit coefficient.
result.normalized: All three scales decide Greater with peak 87-bit coefficients and 238 field products.
result.scope: This demonstrates controlled irrelevant-scale growth. The small fixture does not establish an application speedup.

remaining: Full inward closure and broader repeated-operation computational closure remain in the original goal.
